title: WheelAction
description: Lightweight utility that lets you execute custom commands by middle-clicking a player's name in chat. No more manual typing; just point, click, and run.
body: ### ⚙️ WheelAction **WheelAction** is a lightweight, client-side utility that makes interacting with players via chat instantaneous. No more manually typing out long or complex nicknames—one click is all it takes to get things done. --- ### ✨ Features * **Quick Input:** Press the **Middle Mouse Button (Scroll Wheel)** on a player's name in the chat to automatically insert it into your chat bar. * **Smart Pasting:** The mod instantly grabs the selected player's name, saving you time during intense gameplay or trading. * **Fully Customizable:** Configure which command is triggered upon clicking (e.g., `/msg`, `/tpa`, `/pay`, or any custom command). * **Minimalist Design:** No cluttered UI, no extra overlays, and zero impact on game performance. --- ### 🖼️ Screenshots ![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1614cc120ab417d8dd7cf42f6f5278476584ebb_0.webp) --- ### 🛠️ Configuration By default, middle-clicking a name prepares a private message command (`/duel `). You can change this behavior: **For Fabric:** You need to install **Mod Menu** to access the settings screen in-game. --- ### 📥 Installation & Compatibility * **Client-side only:** This mod is **only required on your computer**. It does not need to be installed on the server. * **Loaders:** Supports **Fabric** * **Dependencies:** * **Fabric:** Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api). --- ### 🛡️ License This project is licensed under **CC BY-ND 4.0** (Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0 International). * **Modpacks:** You are **free** to include this mod in any modpack. * **Modifications:** You are **not allowed** to distribute modified versions of the code or binaries without explicit permission. --- ### 💬 Support & Feedback Found a bug? Have a suggestion for a new feature? * **Discord:** [Join our server](https://discord.gg/ZhjWDUK8RK) * **Donate:** Support the development on [Boosty](https://boosty.to/wheelaction/donate) --- ### 📜 Credits * Discord and Modrinth icons taken from [tr7zw](https://modrinth.com/user/tr7zw).
